name: Film Gate 50's film

metadata.description: Simulador orgánico de proyector e imperfecciones de celuloide con inicio de film leader, gate weave, jitter, flicker, halation y partículas de polvo/rayas.
metadata.author: MGT Team

css: #mgt-film-container { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; font-family: sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } #mgt-film-canvas { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 2; } #mgt-vignette { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 3; mix-blend-mode: multiply; } #mgt-title-wrapper { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); text-align: center; z-index: 1; pointer-events: auto; white-space: nowrap; user-select: none; } #mgt-title { font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.1; } #mgt-subtitle { font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 15px; opacity: 0.85; } #mgt-leader-layer { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 4; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; } #mgt-leader-circle { border: 4px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; width: 280px; height: 280px; position: absolute; box-sizing: border-box; display: none; } #mgt-leader-text { font-family: monospace; font-size: 110px; font-weight: bold; z-index: 5; display: none; }
